title: Migrate Rust lichen-core derivation to upstream AddrForKey/SubnetForKey
description: rust/lichen-core/src/addr.rs:109-117: replace ygg_addr_from_pubkey body with exact upstream AddrForKey (bit-invert pubkey; addr[0]=0x02; addr[1]=leading-1 count as u8 WRAPPING at 256 (Go byte overflow semantics, degenerate all-ones inverted key); skip leading 1s + first 0; pack remaining bits MSB-first into whole bytes DISCARDING trailing partial byte; addr[2:16], zero tail; no hashing - yggdrasil-go@422836ee src/address/address.go). Add subnet_for_key(pubkey)->[u8;8] = AddrForKey then first 8 bytes with byte[0] |= 0x01 (upstream SubnetForKey, 0300::/8). KEEP iid_from_pubkey_bytes UNCHANGED: SHA-512 IID retained for link-local per settled decision; only routable /128 derivation changes. Sweep Rust callers relying on the dead IID-binding invariant (addr[8:16]==SHA512-IID).
